html:
ForgeMCP Landscape Adoption — Stage 2 Report

Date: October 23, 2026
Status: Mandatory local Unreal Editor confirmation checkpoint; Stage 2 is not complete.
Verdict: BLOCKED — ADOPTION NOT COMPLETED

1. Executive summary

The existing Stage 1 checkpoint was reviewed and independently reverified without changing it. Fresh live identity, Landscape baseline and read-only preflight checks passed. Both adoption MCP tools are exposed. One setup_layer request was issued and returned pending_local_approval. Execution stops for the user's required native Editor confirmation. No grant approval, layer creation, sculpt, save, reload, restart or rebuild has been executed by Codex.

This is an interim checkpoint report, not a completed Stage 2 acceptance report. It must be updated after the user confirmation outcome and any authorized subsequent work.

2. Authenticated Editor/session identity

Fresh forge_list_sessions discovery identified one connected Unreal session, [session id redacted] / PID [redacted]. Adapter version 0.2.16-alpha.1 and UE 5.6.1 were checked. Authenticated project-info response:

  "ok": true,
  "session_id": "[redacted]",

    "play_in_editor": false
  }
}

World Partition is enabled. Landscape GUID BD45FDD94EC2A29617B50794F2DE4E9D matches the expected production Landscape. PIE is stopped. Native inspection found 16 loaded streaming proxies and zero unloaded proxies.

4. Adoption request ID and confirmation outcome

Request ID: [redacted]

Pending local approval expires approximately 07:10:52 UTC (03:10:52 EDT), 300 seconds after creation.
Requested grant lifetime after approval: 600 seconds.

Complete native request response:

The tool contract explicitly says it registers a pending request only; no grant, checkpoint, layer, height or project file is created by that call. Current native source corroborates request creation before any local approval or setup operation. The response's read_only field describes native preflight/preparation output; the request did register in-memory pending state.

Confirmation outcome is pending and unverified. Codex has not executed the console command or interacted with the approval dialog. The user must run the exact command in this Editor and personally accept the Yes/No dialog after checking identity and scope. A chat reply alone does not prove approval; a fresh native preflight must confirm approved=true, not revoked/expired/used, and valid checkpoint state before any setup.

If approval is denied, expired or mismatched, stop without mutation. No old grant may be reused.

5. Exact adoption operation executed

Only unreal_request_landscape_adoption was executed after validation. It registered a pending request for setup_layer, actor: /Game/Levels/L_City_World_Master.L_City_World_Master:PersistentLevel.Landscape_UAID_701CE7E46087BA0D03_2100287295

No Landscape preview/apply was called. No adoption layer setup has occurred. The requested setup scope is the full 2041 x 2041 vertex extent [0,0,2040,2040] across the entire selected Landscape, including its 16 streaming proxies. Setup is intended to add one neutral ForgeTerrain edit layer and preserve every original layer and terrain elevation. It does not authorize sculpting, roads/buildings/coastline generation, HLOD rebuilds, World Partition changes, or Ultra Dynamic Sky edits.

6. ForgeTerrain layer state

Pre-request native inspection and preflight confirm ForgeTerrain is absent and requires_layer_setup=true. No creation was attempted. ForgeTerrain usability remains unverified.

7. Original layer preservation results

The original Layer exists, is visible and unlocked. Layer GUID: 198824024FF8A77A01535B86021D9B34. Only this original layer exists at the checkpoint. Landscape dirty=false and layers_up_to_date=true. Post-setup preservation checks remain pending because setup has not executed.

8. Height checksum and geometry comparison

Native original-layer complete height readback checksum: 9f43572fbc2c06ef497da015879cdb23, matching Stage 1. Dimensions: 2041 x 2041. Minimum/maximum local elevations: 0 cm / 0 cm. Landscape GUID is unchanged. The checksum covers the available original-layer height array rather than relying only on extrema. Production source SHA-256 hashes also match the Stage 1 manifest.

No conversion or checksum representation change has occurred. Post-adoption height, neutral-layer and composed geometry validation remain pending.

9. Streaming proxy verification

16 loaded, zero unloaded streaming proxies. 64 registered Landscape components and 64 registered collision components. No proxy replacement, deletion, loading change or component mutation was requested. Post-adoption and reload integrity checks remain pending.

10. Production files modified and saved

None by this operation. All 23 native recovery-scope sources and all 9 supplemental sources matched checkpoint SHA-256 hashes before the pending request. Native namespace file membership also matched. The pending request contract does not write production files.

The only project artifact created by Codex is this requested Markdown report under Saved. The checkpoint was read only and remains unmodified.

The loaded dirty-package inventory was complete and found only the same compiled-in /Script/SlateCore package, with native engine-script provenance verified, and no dirty production content packages. Packages absent from the loaded inventory are not classified as clean by that tool; recovery-scope file bytes were checked separately.

No packages have been selected or saved. After authorized setup, exact dirty package ownership and supported save capability must be verified before saving anything. Local setup approval grants one unsaved setup operation; it does not itself grant a save capability. The user request conditionally authorizes scoped saving only after successful validation, through a supported workflow.

11. Persistence/reload verification

Not performed. No setup or save has executed. After successful authorized setup and save, use a supported safe reload only if it cannot discard unrelated unsaved work. If no such mechanism is available, record persistence verification as incomplete; do not restart or force a reload.

12. Recovery checkpoint reference

[local path]

Reviewed manifest.json, stage1_native_evidence.json and final_verification.json. Independently rehashed all 23 native files plus 9 supplemental files, their backups and isolated reconstruction copies. All 32 source/backup/isolated SHA-256 checks passed, sizes matched, source/backup paths matched the project-relative mapping, and native 23-file namespace membership was unchanged.

Manifest SHA-256: d9de66d61745427b313c5ee7eb5a1f2238d8c76ca2dc5aa0cd277929bbac3388
Total protected source bytes: 9,832,931.

Restore mapping is checkpoint before/<relative_path> to [local path]

13. Outstanding risks or blockers

The required local user confirmation has not yet been observed. This is the current blocking gate.

The native local command opens an identity/scope Yes/No dialog. Only a human Yes permits the native handler to create and verify its own Saved/ForgeLandscapeAdoption/<id> checkpoint and activate the one-operation grant. The pending request expires after 300 seconds; an approved grant lasts the requested 600 seconds. Approval must be inspected live before proceeding.

No completed setup, original-layer preservation after setup, scoped save or persisted reload can be claimed. Save/reload support must be assessed through the currently advertised tools before use; unsupported operations must be reported without bypassing safeguards.

The Stage 1 checkpoint supports byte/path recovery, not a previously tested Unreal restore/reopen. It remains on the same G: volume as production and is not a full project/dependency archive.

14. Final verdict

BLOCKED — ADOPTION NOT COMPLETED

This verdict records the mandatory human-confirmation checkpoint, not a failed Landscape validation. Native preflight and checkpoint validation pass. The request is pending local approval. Do not execute setup, save, reload, or Stage 3 until the user's native confirmation is verified and all subsequent guards pass.
